reuse.why: Extends the existing ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked guard that every provider already calls, but re-types unlinkAccount's field reset instead of extracting and reusing it.

duplication.why: The eight-field reset in the replace path is a verbatim copy of the db.updateAccount block in unlinkAccount.

placement.why: The takeover is handled in the shared link guard in accounts/app.ts, where the link rules already live, though a function named 'ensure...IsNotLinked' now performs an unlink.

scope.why: Only the flag, its threading through the six link handlers, the guard and one test change.

maintainability.why: The guard's name no longer matches what it does, and the copied reset will drift if the unlink action's fields change.
